# Yandex SpeechKit Cloud

Upstream: https://github.com/yandex/speechkitcloud
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE in this directory).

Vendored here: `webspeechkit/` (browser voice recognition and synthesis) and `proto/` (the speech protocol). The checked-in `go/asr-client.osx` binary from upstream is not included.

This is a client for Yandex's hosted speech service. It is not Yandex's recognition model, and it does not run offline.
